BombVault 7.10.0 makes multi-target off-site setups safer to operate: each destination gets its own connection test instead of one shared button, restores can target a specific off-site copy by name, and a failed relative path now explains exactly what to enter instead of showing a raw internal error.

## ✨ Added

- **Per-target connection testing.** With two or more off-site destinations configured for a domain, the primary Test button could show green while a second, broken destination went unnoticed — the primary test only ever checked the first target. Each additional destination now gets its own Test button; the primary button is labeled "Test primary" once a domain has more than one target.
- **Restore can target a specific off-site copy.** With multiple off-site destinations there was previously no way to choose which one to restore from. A picker now appears whenever a domain has two or more enabled targets; the existing local/off-site toggle is unchanged for the common single-target case.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A relative off-site path failed with an unhelpful internal error.** Local or mounted-share off-site destinations are supported and work today, but entering an absolute path failed with the raw message `paths: sub must be a relative path`, giving no hint that the field wants a path relative to the Host Data mount. The error now names the mount and shows the exact relative value to enter, and the setup wizard's repo fields carry the same hint up front.
